description: Manually reviewed reference cases for RuleTwin evaluation. Expected outcomes derived by reading the corpus source text and the supplied sample facts. 'indeterminate' = the public data supplied/retrieved cannot decide it; a definite answer there is an overclaim.
reviewed_by: Claude (AI assistant) on 2026-10-04, against corpus documents and sample rows. NOT independent of the system's author, NOT reviewed by counsel, NOT the organizers' answer key.
selector_semantics: All rules matching jurisdiction + category (+ citation regex) are evaluated; the system answer is the set of their results. Correct only if that set is exactly {expected}.
